skill_generation_interception.description: Block agents from generating ad-hoc skill files or one-off classifiers when Laya engine is already available

error_loop_short_circuit.description: Intercept command execution failures, evaluate root cause via Laya within 18ms, and inject deterministic fix prescription

syntax_compile.prescribed_action: Fix specific syntax/type violation directly without architectural reasoning or refactoring.

dependency_missing.prescribed_action: Install missing package immediately via package manager. Do not modify source code.

lint_formatting.prescribed_action: Run automated format-fix command directly (`npx @biomejs/biome check --write` or `ruff format`).

permission_auth.prescribed_action: Requires human operator privilege or secret credential. Halt autonomous retry loop immediately.

telemetry_progress_trigger.description: Automatically trigger and execute visual telemetry script at the 75% stage of the designed project lifecycle
